data.cultural_impact: The name Subod has deep cultural roots in Hindu society, as it is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with positive qualities such as good, auspicious, and prosperous. In Hindu culture, names are considered sacred and can have a significant impact on one's identity and future. The name Subod is believed to bring happiness, success, and good fortune to the bearer.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the spiritual significance of the name Subod lies in its association with positive qualities that are valued in the spiritual path. The name Subod is believed to represent the inner qualities of a person who is pure, good, and brings prosperity. It is a reminder to strive for inner purity, good character, and to bring positive energy and prosperity to oneself and others. The name Subod is a constant affirmation of the individual's commitment to spiritual growth and positive action in the world.

historical_references.reference: Subodhita was a celebrated sage and one of the thirty-two Munis (sages) of Nalanda University. His name is also mentioned in the Rigveda as Subodhana, which means 'he who illuminates the mind'.
historical_references.context: Nalanda University was a major Buddhist learning center in ancient India.

historical_references.reference: Subodhadeva was a king of the Chedi Dynasty in central India, ruling between 1018-1034 CE. He is also referred to as Subodh II, as he was the second king of his lineage to bear this name.
historical_references.context: Chedi Dynasty was a lineage of kings ruling over central India, with its capital at Ujjain.
